threshold: max validation F1, highest threshold breaks ties
augmentation: resize 384x384; independent rotation +/-10 degrees; ImageNet normalization
amp_overflow_policy: retry same accumulation group up to 12 times at halved scale; CUDA RNG restored; never update bad gradients
architecture: Shared ConvNeXt-Tiny pooled normalized 768D per side -> concat 1536 -> Linear256 GELU Linear1
initialization: A0 ImageNet file only; never A0 best.pt
augmentation_rng: 42 + epoch*100000 + sample index; shared epoch tensor for persistent workers
head_parameters: MLP only; backbone includes final LayerNorm
